I have the authority to approve a temporary route change and release the campaign to Cell 3, but company procedure requires me to conduct a pre-release review with quality, maintenance, materials, and safety before I can sign off on an alternate-cell campaign. I need each of you to weigh in so we can assess whether routing this campaign to Cell 3 is viable from a quality, equipment, materials, and safety standpoint.
